changed.title: At the mean rank budget every control-mask sum is block diagonal with prescribed local ranks on distinct regular pencil planes
changed.statement:
let F := ZMod 2
∀ (q l : ℕ) (s : Fin l → ℕ),
  let V := Fin q → F
  let I := Σ i : Fin l, Fin (2*s i)
  let M := Matrix I I F
  let dot := fun (a z : V) => ∑ k, a k * z k
  ∀ (a b : Fin l → V), (∀ i, a i ≠ 0 ∧ b i ≠ 0 ∧ a i ≠ b i) →
    let line := fun i : Fin l => ({a i,b i,a i+b i} : Finset V)
    Function.Injective line →
    ∀ (U W : (i : Fin l) → Matrix (Fin (2*s i)) (Fin (2*s i)) F),
      (∀ i, (U i).rank = 2*s i ∧ (W i).rank = 2*s i ∧ (U i + W i).rank = 2*s i) →
      let K := fun (z : V) =>
        Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun i => dot (a i) z • U i + dot (b i) z • W i)
      ∀ t : ℕ, 2*t = 3*(∑ i, s i) →
        ∀ (R : Fin t → M) (c : Fin t → V), (∀ j, (R j).rank ≤ 2) →
          (∀ z : V, K z = ∑ j, dot (c j) z • R j) →
          let group := fun u : V => ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j => c j = u), R j
          (∀ j, c j ≠ 0 ∧ (R j).rank = 2) ∧
            ∀ u : V, (group u).rank = 2*(Finset.univ.filter (fun j => c j = u)).card ∧
              ∃ D : (i : Fin l) → Matrix (Fin (2*s i)) (Fin (2*s i)) F,
                group u = Matrix.blockDiagonal' D ∧
                ∀ i, (D i).rank = if u ∈ line i then s i else 0
changed.unlocks: If a common circuit attains the mean bound, recover exactly how much matrix rank each control mask must supply to each block.
changed.context: At the mean budget rank subadditivity is tight on every input, since a block is active three quarters of the time and a nonzero mask half. Active row and column spaces lie in the output spaces. A mask outside a plane can fire while that block is zero, excluding it from both supports. Two distinct planes share at most one nonzero mask, so an off-diagonal block can come from only one mask sum; activating it forces that entry to vanish. On each local nonzero choice two sums attain total rank 2s. The three pair equations give rank s for each.

changed.title: Maximum number of distinct outputs of parity-locked pivot sensors with specified readers
changed.statement:
∀ (n : Nat) (D : Fin n → Finset (Fin n)),
  letI : ∀ p : Prop, Decidable p := Classical.propDecidable
  let W := Fin n → ZMod 2
  let edge := fun i j : Fin n => j ∈ D i
  let reach := Relation.ReflTransGen edge
  let src := fun i : Fin n => ∀ j, reach j i → reach i j
  let cls := fun i : Fin n => Finset.univ.filter (fun j => reach i j ∧ reach j i)
  let s := ((Finset.univ.filter src).image cls).card
  let localT := fun (T : Fin n → W → ZMod 2) =>
    ∀ i x y, (∀ j ∈ D i, x j = y j) → T i x = T i y
  let out := fun (T : Fin n → W → ZMod 2) (x : W) (i : Fin n) => x i + T i x
  let lock := fun T => ∀ x, (∑ i : Fin n, out T x i) = 0
  let size := fun T => (Finset.univ.image (out T)).card
  (∀ j, ∃ i, edge i j) →
  (∀ T, localT T → lock T → size T ≤ 2^(n-s)) ∧
    ∃ owner : Fin n → Fin n, (∀ j, edge (owner j) j) ∧
      let T := fun (i : Fin n) (x : W) => ∑ j, if owner j = i then x j else 0
      localT T ∧ lock T ∧ size T = 2^(n-s) ∧
        ∀ v : W, let count := Nat.card {x : W // out T x = v}
                 count = 0 ∨ count = 2^s
changed.unlocks: Would give the exact number of distinct outputs attainable by local rules under a global parity constraint.
changed.context: Fix the inputs outside the source components. Varying one source changes only its own outputs, so its block parity is fixed on that slice. Multiply the bounds for these blocks and sum over slices. For attainment choose one directed cycle per source, then grow outward from the cycles, assigning each newly reached bit to its reader. In each resulting part, sums of edge columns along paths span the even words. Rank and nullity give the image size and every nonempty fiber size. Estimated proof time is 180 to 300 minutes.

changed.title: Common blockwise projections localize individual binary generators and diagonalize each mask sum within a conditional rank-loss budget
changed.statement:
let F := ZMod 2
∀ (q l t : ℕ) (m n : Fin l → ℕ),
  let V := Fin q → F
  let I := Σ i : Fin l, Fin (m i)
  let J := Σ i : Fin l, Fin (n i)
  let dot := fun (u z : V) => ∑ k, u k * z k
  ∀ (P : Fin l → Submodule F V),
    (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Module.finrank F (P i ⊓ P j : Submodule F V) ≤ 1) →
    let zeroAt := fun i : Fin l => @Finset.filter V (fun z =>
      ∀ u ∈ P i, dot u z = 0) (Classical.decPred _) Finset.univ
    ∀ (D : (i : Fin l) → V → Matrix (Fin (m i)) (Fin (n i)) F)
      (R : Fin t → Matrix I J F) (c : Fin t → V),
      (∀ i z, z ∈ zeroAt i → D i z = 0) →
      let X := fun z : V => Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun i => D i z)
      let on := fun z : V => Finset.univ.filter (fun j => dot (c j) z ≠ 0)
      let loss := fun z : V => (∑ j ∈ on z, (R j).rank) - (X z).rank
      (∀ z, X z = ∑ j ∈ on z, R j) →
      ∃ (L : (i : Fin l) → Matrix (Fin (m i)) (Fin (m i)) F)
        (T : (i : Fin l) → Matrix (Fin (n i)) (Fin (n i)) F),
        let G := fun j : Fin t => Matrix.blockDiagonal' L * R j * Matrix.blockDiagonal' T
        (∀ i, L i * L i = L i ∧ T i * T i = T i ∧
          (zeroAt i).card * ((m i - (L i).rank) + (n i - (T i).rank)) ≤
            2 * ∑ z ∈ zeroAt i, loss z) ∧
        (∀ j, c j ≠ 0 → ∀ x y, (c j ∉ P x.1 ∨ c j ∉ P y.1) → G j x y = 0) ∧
        ∀ u : V, u ≠ 0 →
          ∃ E : (i : Fin l) → Matrix (Fin (m i)) (Fin (n i)) F,
            (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j => c j = u), G j) = Matrix.blockDiagonal' E ∧
            ∀ i, u ∉ P i → E i = 0
changed.unlocks: If only a few rank units are lost, compress all mask sums at once while retaining a lower bound on the surviving dimensions of each block.
changed.context: Restrict to the profiles killing one control space. Every mask outside that space activates on half of them. Project to the block rows and columns and apply the activation-frequency rank bound. Kill the joint projected column span by a left projection and the joint row span by right multiplication, paying the sum of dimensions. Do this for every block. For off-diagonal block positions at most one nonzero mask belongs to both control spaces. Activate it: the compressed target vanishes there, forcing that mask sum to vanish too.

changed.title: The scheduled common-key rule propagates mixed endpoint observations with an arbitrary set of erased driving bits
changed.statement:
∀ (k r h : ℕ), k % 2 = 1 →
  let rot := fun (s word : Nat) =>
    ((word <<< (s % k)) ||| (word >>> (k - s % k))) % 2 ^ k
  let step := fun (word : Nat) =>
    (List.range k).foldl (fun acc i =>
      acc ||| ((xor (word.testBit i)
        (!(word.testBit ((i + 1) % k)) && word.testBit ((i + 2) % k))).toNat <<< i)) 0
  let constant := fun (j : Nat) => 3 ^ (k + j) % 2 ^ k
  let first := fun (rowKey rowName : Nat) =>
    (List.range r).foldl (fun rowState rowIndex =>
      step (rowState ^^^ rot 1 rowState ^^^ rot (k - 1) rowState) ^^^
        rot (2 * rowIndex) rowKey ^^^ constant (rowIndex + 1)) (rot 1 rowKey ^^^ rowName)
  let second := fun (colKey colName : Nat) =>
    (List.range r).foldl (fun colState colIndex =>
      step (colState ^^^ rot 2 colState ^^^ rot (k - 2) colState) ^^^
        rot (3 * (colIndex + 1) + 1) colKey ^^^ constant (r + (colIndex + 1)))
      (rot 3 colKey ^^^ colName)
  let V := Fin 5 × Fin k
  let word := fun (v : V → Bool) (track : Fin 5) =>
    ∑ j : Fin k, (v (track,j)).toNat * 2^j.val
  let agrees := fun (v : V → Bool) =>
    word v 3 = first (word v 2) (word v 0) ∧
    word v 4 = second (word v 2) (word v 1)
  let branch := if k % 3 = 0 then 4^r else 1
  let rounds := 512*((r+1)*(Nat.clog 2 (k+1)+1)+h+1)
  ∃ (m : ℕ) (F : Finset (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Sum V (Fin m)))),
    m + (∑ C ∈ F, C.card) ≤ 16777216*(k+1)*(r+1)*branch*(h+1)^2*(Nat.clog 2 (3*k+1)+1)*2^h ∧
    (∀ C ∈ F, C.card ≤ 3) ∧
    (∀ v : V → Bool, agrees v ↔ ∃ aux : Fin m → Bool,
      PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfies (Sum.elim v aux) (↑F : Set _)) ∧
    ∀ (rowRev colRev : Bool) (ρ : V → Option Bool),
      let driver := fun j : V => j.1 = 2 ∨
        j.1 = (if rowRev then 3 else 0) ∨ j.1 = (if colRev then 4 else 1)
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : V => driver j ∧ ρ j = none)).card ≤ h →
      let seed : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Literal (Sum V (Fin m))) :=
        {l | ∃ raw : V, l.1 = Sum.inl raw ∧ ρ raw = some l.2}
      let advance := fun S : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Literal (Sum V (Fin m))) =>
        S ∪ {l | ∃ C ∈ F, l ∈ C ∧ ∀ other ∈ C, other ≠ l →
          PEqualNP.Search.negLit other ∈ S}
      let known := (advance^[rounds]) seed
      let complete := fun v : V → Bool => agrees v ∧
        ∀ (raw : V) (sign : Bool), ρ raw = some sign → v raw = sign
      ((¬ ∃ v, complete v) ↔ ∃ C ∈ F, ∀ l ∈ C, PEqualNP.Search.negLit l ∈ known) ∧
      ((∃ v, complete v) → ∀ raw : V, ∀ sign : Bool,
        (∀ v, complete v → v raw = sign) ↔ (Sum.inl raw, sign) ∈ known)
changed.unlocks: It covers the partial-key observations between the full-key inverse bounds and unrestricted five-word propagation.
changed.context: Hash the three driving words jointly. Under each syndrome of a separating matrix the surviving driver is unique, including its common key. Evaluate each forward branch, invert each coprime reverse branch, and at a singular reverse mixer enumerate the two starting bits with a wrap test. Within each syndrome conjoin independent branch feasibility using the same key. A sign survives only with a compatible leaf on its branch and some leaf on the other. Aggregate exclusions over syndromes, then use each orientation to imply physical literals.

changed.title: A circuit finds minimum-rank raw-key parities for affine cyclic histories and counts the joint terminal matches
changed.statement:
∀ (k r t p h : Nat) (hk : 0 < k),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let W := Fin k → F
  let ix := fun n : Nat => (⟨n % k, Nat.mod_lt _ hk⟩ : Fin k)
  let rot := fun (s : Nat) (x : W) (j : Fin k) => x (ix (j.val+k-s % k))
  let gap := fun (b : Bool) => if b then 2 else 1
  let start := fun (b : Bool) => if b then 3 else 1
  let feed := fun (b : Bool) (t : Nat) => if b then 3*(t+1)+1 else 2*t
  let closed := fun (N : Nat) (watch : Bool → Nat → Fin k → Bool) =>
    ∀ (b : Bool) (t : Nat), t < N → ∀ j : Fin k, watch b (t+1) j = true →
      ∀ e : Fin 3, let i := ix (j.val+e.val)
        watch b t i = true ∧ watch b t (ix (i.val+gap b)) = true ∧
        watch b t (ix (i.val+k-gap b % k)) = true
  ∀ (watch : Bool → Nat → Fin k → Bool) (side : Fin t → Bool) (site : Fin t → Fin k),
    closed (r+1) watch → (∀ i, watch (side i) (r+1) (site i) = true) →
    let P := min k p
    let H := min t h
    let branch := if t ≤ h then 3 else
      max 3 (((2 : Nat)^(H+1)-1)*(2^(min P (H+1)+1)-1))
    let inputs := (2+2*(r+1))*k+t
    ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (flag : Fin (inputs+C.size))
      (maskWire : Fin P → Fin k → Fin (inputs+C.size))
      (ans : Fin (k+1) → Fin (inputs+C.size)),
      PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack inputs C ∧
      C.output = flag.val ∧
      C.size ≤ 2^60*(k+r+t+6)^22*((2*branch)^P + 2^(P+H)) ∧
      ∀ (name : Bool → W) (c : Bool → Fin (r+1) → W) (target : Fin t → F),
        let state := fun (b : Bool) (key : W) (n : Nat) =>
          ((List.finRange (r+1)).take n).foldl (fun z tick =>
            let y := fun i : Fin k =>
              z i + z (ix (i.val+gap b)) + z (ix (i.val+k-gap b % k))
            fun j : Fin k => y j + (1+y (ix (j.val+1)))*y (ix (j.val+2)) +
              rot (feed b tick.val) key j + c b tick j) (rot (start b) key + name b)
        let probe := fun (key : W) (i : Fin t) => state (side i) key (r+1) (site i)
        let works := fun (Q : Fin P → W) =>
          let D := {u : W // ∀ i, dotProduct (Q i) u = 0}
          let polar := fun (a : W) (i : Fin t) (xy : D × D) =>
            probe a i + probe (a+xy.1.val) i + probe (a+xy.2.val) i +
              probe (a+xy.1.val+xy.2.val) i
          (∀ (a : W) (b : Bool) (n : Nat), n ≤ r → ∀ j : Fin k, watch b n j = true →
            ∀ x y : D, state b a n j + state b (a+x.val) n j + state b (a+y.val) n j +
              state b (a+x.val+y.val) n j = 0) ∧
          (∀ a : W, Module.finrank F (Submodule.span F (Set.range (polar a))) ≤ h)
        let price := fun Q : Fin P → W => Module.finrank F (Submodule.span F (Set.range Q))
        let pack := fun w : W => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin k => decide (w j ≠ 0))
        let bits := pack (name false) ++ pack (name true) ++
          (List.ofFn (fun i => pack (c false i))).flatten ++
          (List.ofFn (fun i => pack (c true i))).flatten ++
          List.ofFn (fun i : Fin t => decide (target i ≠ 0))
        let wire := fun i : Fin (inputs+C.size) => (C.wires bits).getD i.val false
        let chosen := fun a b => (if wire (maskWire a b) then 1 else 0 : F)
        let count := ((Finset.univ : Finset W).filter (fun key => ∀ i, probe key i = target i)).card
        (wire flag = true ↔ ∃ Q : Fin P → W, works Q) ∧
          (wire flag = true → works chosen ∧ ∀ Q : Fin P → W, works Q → price chosen ≤ price Q) ∧
          (∀ i : Fin (k+1), wire (ans i) = ((if wire flag then count else 0).testBit i.val))
changed.unlocks: Finds a least-rank set of key parities and counts common passing keys without being supplied any key directions.
changed.context: At each candidate kernel inspect all its cosets by singleton and paired basis shifts. For an earliest prefix violation branch on either operand slope or their sum. If terminal rank exceeds h, take h+1 independent polars on that cell. A solution kills some combination of rank 2a at most twice the remaining cut budget. Branch on the nonzero span of a+1 image basis covectors per eligible combination. Lift each cut and search to depth p. Select a shallowest success, then count its cosets by quadratic sums. Estimated 280 minutes.

changed.title: Feasible positive triples using each name twice encode a permanent in counts of optimal fan-in-two AND/OR equality functions
changed.statement:
let header := fun n : Nat => List.replicate n true ++ [false]
let frame := fun xs : List Bool => xs.flatMap (fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false]
let field := fun (k z : Nat) => (List.range (k.log2+1)).map (fun i => z.testBit i)
let fast := fun f : List Bool → List Bool =>
  ∃ M : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) f,
    ∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)
∃ write read residue : List Bool → List Bool, fast write ∧ fast read ∧ fast residue ∧
  ∀ (n : Nat), 0 < n → ∀ A : Fin n → Fin n → Bool,
    let v := 2*n
    let e := fun h : Nat => 2*(n+h)
    let q := fun h : Nat => 2*e h+1
    let cells := (List.finRange n).flatMap (fun i => (List.finRange n).map (fun j => (i,j)))
    let B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Nat := fun i j => (A i j).toNat
    let mat := cells.toFinset.powerset.filter (fun S =>
      (∀ z ∈ S, A z.1 z.2 = true) ∧ (S.image Prod.fst).card = S.card ∧
      (S.image Prod.snd).card = S.card)
    let m := fun r : Nat => (mat.filter (fun S => S.card = r)).card
    let I := fun j : Nat => Nat.card {P : Equiv.Perm (Fin j) // Function.Involutive P}
    let links := fun h : Nat =>
      let port := fun (block j : Nat) => block*q h +
        (if j = 0 then 0 else if j = e h+1 then 2*e h else 2*j-1)
      cells.flatMap (fun z =>
        let l := port z.1.val (2*z.2.val)
        let l' := port z.1.val (2*z.2.val+1)
        let r := port (n+z.2.val) (2*z.1.val)
        let r' := port (n+z.2.val) (2*z.1.val+1)
        if A z.1 z.2 then [(l,r),(l',r')] else [(l,l'),(r,r')]) ++
      (List.range v).flatMap (fun u => (List.range (h+1)).map (fun j =>
        (port u (2*n+2*j),port u (2*n+2*j+1))))
    let size := fun h : Nat => v*q h+2*(links h).length
    let rows := fun h : Nat =>
      (List.range v).flatMap (fun u => (List.range (e h)).map (fun j =>
        let b := u*q h+2*j
        [b,b+1,b+2])) ++ (links h).zipIdx.flatMap (fun z =>
          let b := v*q h+2*z.2
          [[b,b+1,z.1.1],[b,b+1,z.1.2]])

      let Fn := (Fin k → Bool) → (Fin k → Bool) → Bool

        PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*k ∧
        PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun i j : Fin k => decide (i=j)) C ∧

      (∀ R ∈ rows h, R.length = 3 ∧ R.Nodup ∧ ∀ u ∈ R, u < size h) ∧
      (∀ u : Fin (size h), ((rows h).filter (fun R => decide (u.val ∈ R))).length = 2) ∧

        4^r*m r*(q h)^(2*n-2*r)*I (2*n-2*r))) ∧
    read (header n ++ (List.range (n+1)).flatMap (fun h => frame (Z h).bits)) = B.permanent.bits ∧

      let h := (4*n+1)*(d^2-1)/4
      q h = (4*n+1)*d^2 ∧
      Z h % (d^2) = (4^n*B.permanent) % (d^2) ∧

changed.context: Give each matrix cell two leaf ports at each endpoint. At a one wire them across twice. At a zero wire locally on each side. Pair spare leaves locally. A local wire cannot activate since its path has only one free root. Each selected graph edge has two wires and two orientations. Free paths choose roots and the residual roots pair arbitrarily. The total is a degree-n polynomial in q squared with constant 4^n times the permanent. Interpolate at n+1 nodes. For odd d choose q=(4n+1)d squared, then invert 4^n modulo d squared. All integers have polynomial bit length.

changed.title: All joint size and signed-score counts of optimal fan-in-two AND/OR equality functions modulo a power of two admit one deterministic machine
changed.statement:
let header := fun j : Nat => List.replicate j true ++ [false]
let bits := fun (w z : Nat) => (List.range w).map (fun h => z.testBit h)
let pairs := fun k : Nat => (List.finRange k).flatMap (fun i =>
    ((List.finRange k).filter (fun j => decide (i < j))).map (fun j => (i,j)))
∃ (M : Turing.TM2ComputableAux Bool Bool) (c : Nat), (∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)) ∧
∀ (n : Nat), 2 ≤ n →
  ∀ (hard : List (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n)))
    (soft : List ((Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n)) × Bool)),
  let m := soft.length
  let ends := fun e : Fin n × Fin n => ({e.1,e.2} : Finset (Fin n))
  let E := (pairs n).toFinset.filter (fun e =>
    ∀ z ∈ hard, ¬(ends e ⊆ z.1) ∧ ¬(ends e ⊆ z.2))
  let lists := fun (S : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) (t : (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n)) × Bool) =>
    Disjoint t.1.1 t.1.2 ∧ ∀ e ∈ S, ends e ⊆ t.1.1 ∨ ends e ⊆ t.1.2
  (∀ S ⊆ E, 2 ≤ S.card →
    (∀ e ∈ S, ∀ f ∈ S, e ≠ f → Disjoint (ends e) (ends f)) →
    (soft.filter (fun t => t.2 && decide (lists S t))).length =
      (soft.filter (fun t => !t.2 && decide (lists S t))).length) →
  let Fn := (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool
  let obs := fun (f : Fn) (R T : Finset (Fin n)) =>
    f (fun i => decide (i ∈ R)) (fun j => decide (j ∈ T))
  let valid := fun f : Fn => (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*n ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun i j : Fin n => decide (i=j)) C ∧
    ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)) ∧
    ∀ z ∈ hard, obs f z.1 z.2 = false
  let code := fun f : Fn => (pairs n).map (fun e => obs f (ends e) ∅)
  let size := fun f : Fn => ((code f).filter id).length
  let score := fun f : Fn => (soft.filter (fun t => decide (obs f t.1.1 t.1.2 = t.2))).length
  let bank := fun B : Finset (Fin n) => (List.finRange n).map (fun i => decide (i ∈ B))
  let input := header n ++ header hard.length ++ hard.flatMap (fun z => bank z.1 ++ bank z.2) ++
    header m ++ soft.flatMap (fun t => bank t.1.1 ++ bank t.1.2 ++ [t.2])
  ∀ k : Nat, 1 ≤ k →
    let x := header k ++ input
    let count := fun s j : Nat => Nat.card {f : Fn // valid f ∧ size f = s ∧ score f = j}
    let output := (List.range (n/2+1)).flatMap (fun s =>
      (List.range (m+1)).flatMap (fun j => bits k (count s j % 2^k)))
    Nonempty (Turing.TM2OutputsInTime M.tm (x.map M.inputAlphabet.invFun)
      (some (output.map M.outputAlphabet.invFun)) ((x.length+2)^(c*(k+1))))
changed.unlocks: Computes every count modulo a specified power of two with an explicit uniform time bound. Multiple and imperfect agreements are included.
changed.context: Give red edges weight X and blue edges weight one. The coefficient of X^((m+1)s+j) in the symmetric adjacency hafnian counts the fitting functions in that bin exactly. Compute every coefficient modulo 2^k directly by Hirai and Namba, preprint Theorem 2.1. Its recurrence has polynomial branching per unit of k, giving time L^(C(k+1)) with unary k. Deal with contradictory negatives by emitting zeros. Output k low bits per bin.

Test an AND/OR witness against all 256 inputs, then prove that shorter circuits with at most one NOT fail using a gate lower bound or an exhaustive certificate. For a saving, exhibit the one-NOT circuit and exclude every shorter or equal-sized AND/OR circuit. The graph reader will inspect the shared wires and the input of the NOT in each saving. An equality removes this graph from the search for a saving.
